messages:
aisha_cs: Quick heads-up on Ridgeway Health — renewal in ~6w and we’re seeing a ~22% MoM drop in API usage after their recent prompt churn. Proactive idea: run a 48h canary that routes 90% to an int8 compact variant and 10% to the current FP32 model as fallback. Goal: reduce cost per token and stabilize p95 latency. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/ridgeway/ops. Any immediate blockers?

jordan_ridgeway: Curious — how much quality hit are we expecting? We can’t risk hallucinations for their clinical summaries.

aisha_cs: Good call. We ran a 500-sample eval against their top prompt set — avg quality delta ~1.2% (automated metric) and no safety-policy regressions. I can share the evaluation CSV and sample diffs.

sam_infra: Sounds reasonable. Couple infra notes: int8 path is safe for their model family but watch KV cache interaction for long conversations. Recommend setting `kv_cache_size: auto` and `batching: adaptive` for the canary. Also set a hard token cap on canary responses (e.g., 1024) to avoid tail latency spikes. Example route config: 
```
route_policy:
  - weight: 90
    model: redwood-compact-v1-int8
  - weight: 10
    model: redwood-rlhf-v2
canary_window: 48h
max_tokens: 1024
request_cap: 10000/day
```

lee_solutions: Add a quick probe: if the prompt indicates multi-step extraction or expected length > 512 tokens, divert to FP32 variant. That will catch the clinical long-form cases. Something like: `if estimated_tokens > 512 or requires_table_extraction -> route FP32`.

ops-bot: Canary created: `ridgeway-int8-canary` (90/10 split). Policy: 48h window, 10k req/day cap, auto-metric-checks enabled. Started at 2026-03-22T15:02:25Z.

jordan_ridgeway: OK great, let's run it. Please escalate if any quality-alerts show up — we need manual review on any low-confidence answers. Thanks :pray:

aisha_cs: Action items: 1) I’ll push the eval CSV and daily diffs to the workspace. 2) @sam_infra please finalize the canary with the `kv_cache_size` and token cap. 3) @lee_solutions please draft the routing playbook and the probe rules. I’ll check in at 24h and we’ll decide expand/rollback at 48h. :thumbsup:
